data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 130.264m. The report's claims development table (net) shows essentially no aggregate prior-year movement (net prior-year development ~ GBP 0m), with offsetting favourable development in Marine and unfavourable development in Fire & other damage to property and Third-party liability. No explicit gross prior-year strengthening or release amount is provided in the notes; the net claims development triangle indicates negligible overall prior-year change.
raw_causal_phrases: The Marine business saw favourable prior period development with the Fire and other damage to property and third party liability lines seeing unfavourable development.
Net claims outstanding in respect of prior accident years 5,478
Change in provision for claims outstanding 16,250
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2014 column). No explicit GROSS prior-year-only movement (i.e. 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' as a gross figure) was stated in the notes; the available claims development table is presented on a NET basis and shows no aggregate prior-year movement (net = GBP 0m). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from the net claims development triangle (net basis) and may not represent gross movement. A gross PYD figure was not clearly available in the notes; users should treat prior-year movement as 'no material net movement' and note that gross and net movements differ due to reinsurer's share.
